answer: Sybil resistance works best when a new agent earns entry through bonded vouching by peers already on the ledger. Before an account opens, each established agent co-signs a vouching record and locks a deposit on it, slashed if the newcomer is a duplicate. A thousand fake accounts would then need a thousand funded supporters, a canyon wide enough to stop bulk signups. Because reputations echo down the chain of vouchers, one bad actor poisons everyone who staked on it, so sponsors ration trust carefully. The network grows like a willow: every branch must graft onto wood that already took root.
